_note: Base for a new rulebook. A stub has an empty checklist; the reviewer writes exactly 6 items the first time a detail of that type is reviewed. Severity is CRITICAL (water or structure failure), MAJOR (code or mandate non-compliance) or ADVISORY (lesson learned, best practice). Optional per item: "when": {"key": <project_context key>, "in": [values]}, and "good": path to a small image of a correct detail.
